corrections.reason: Pass-1 verdict is correct. Subject matter (MBTI in corporate/workplace context) is shared, but the organizing frame shifts from 'niche intersection label' to 'fully scoped audience persona with psychographic attributes and product affinities' — a frame change, not a subset restriction. Subsumption test: 'Corporate Professionals & Team-Oriented Individuals persona is a specific way of being MBTI under the corporate setting' — FALSE; the POST is an elaborated audience segment, not a subtype of the PRE intersection label. Reframed is the correct tier. Narrowed was the runner-up; it does not pass the subsumption test.

Neighborhood gate fails: the only shared umbrella would be 'identity/self-presentation' or 'MBTI as broad topic,' which sits above the abstraction ceiling. Nearest-counterpart search confirmed: Narrowed/Reframed/Elaborated/Expanded all fail. New stands.
Rejection is correct: different conceptual domains; forcing the pairing would require ignoring PRE's explicit 'corporate setting' framing.
